# OmegaHive versioned JSON API — response schemas

**Generated by `scripts/emit_api_schemas.py`. Do not hand-edit.** Schema version `1`.

Source of truth: `src/omegahive/api/models.py`. Regenerate after any change:

```sh
uv run python scripts/emit_api_schemas.py
```

Routes: `GET /api/v1/health` -> `HealthResponse`; `GET /api/v1/portfolio` -> `PortfolioResponse`; `GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/tasks/{task_id}` -> `TaskDetailResponse`. Every non-2xx response on every route is `ErrorResponse`.

## `ErrorResponse`

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "The typed body of every non-2xx response from this API. `error` is a stable,\nmachine-matchable code (not the HTTP reason phrase); `detail` is for a human.",
  "properties": {
    "detail": {
      "title": "Detail",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "error": {
      "enum": [
        "unknown_run",
        "unknown_task",
        "database_unavailable",
        "invalid_request"
      ],
      "title": "Error",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "error",
    "detail"
  ],
  "title": "ErrorResponse",
  "type": "object"
}
```
